title: Phynd Firstmate Local Software Factory — Milestone 1

epics.title: Prompt architecture and quality baseline
epics.goal: Fix the verbosity failure before asking the factory to design or implement anything else.
tasks: Document the current Pi system prompt files, AGENTS/CLAUDE context, communication-discipline skill, role prompts, setup-time prompt copies, and child-harness prompt injection.
Prompt inventory with owner, scope, precedence, and hash.
No prompt source or injection path remains implicit.
Build representative prompts for compact chat, detailed technical design, implementation plan, task graph, PR review, incident response, setup diagnosis, and Lavish artifact delivery.
Every output mode and high-risk failure is represented.
Build a repeatable prompt evaluation runner
Launch isolated Pi/Luna xhigh sessions against current and candidate prompts; capture tool calls, output artifacts, token counts, and required-section coverage.
Python eval CLI with JSON results.
The same fixture can compare prompt versions without hand scoring.
Add CHAT, ARTIFACT, BRIEF, REVIEW, and INCIDENT modes with explicit completeness and presentation requirements.
Every task has one resolved output contract before dispatch.
Write the scoped Firstmate driver prompt
Replace the global concision wording with a small mode-aware driver contract: concise chat, complete artifacts, complete briefs, evidence-first reviews, mandatory Lavish artifact gate.
The prompt contains no arbitrary output-length target and explicitly exempts artifacts, specs, code, tests, and evidence from concision.
Limit brevity rules to chat and progress. Replace the blanket ban on implementation tours with a rule that requested implementation detail belongs in the artifact, not chat.
A requested design or task list cannot be shortened by this skill.
Create minimal prompts for design author, adversarial reviewer, implementer, PR self-reviewer, incident investigator, and route scout.
Children receive only role-relevant constraints; the driver prompt is not sprayed globally.
Scope Pi prompt injection to the Firstmate code root
Install the driver contract as project-local .pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md rather than a global prompt that affects unrelated projects.
A Pi worker in another repository does not inherit the Firstmate driver presentation policy.
Stop treating ~/.claude/phynd-concise.md as a universal launch prompt. Claude workers receive an explicit role prompt through their launch profile.
Existing user-owned files are never deleted; stale Firstmate-managed copies are detected and retired safely.
Report active prompt provenance at session start
Expose driver prompt version/hash, output-mode policy version, and role-prompt version in the startup digest.
The captain can prove which prompt governed the session.
Measure chat compactness, artifact completeness, required-section recall, Lavish invocation, unsupported claims, and decision surfacing.
Candidate preserves or improves chat signal while achieving 100% required artifact coverage on golden fixtures.
Present the A/B report and exact prompt in Lavish with Approve, Revise, and Reject controls.
Prompt approval receipt bound to prompt hash.
No later milestone uses the new prompt until explicit approval.

epics.title: Mandatory Lavish artifact execution
epics.goal: Make rich human review a hard workflow for artifact-class deliverables instead of a model preference.
tasks: Create the single owner for Lavish help/design/playbook discovery, artifact authoring, open, poll, feedback, revision, acceptance, and retirement.
Internal skill with narrow AGENTS trigger.
The full workflow is stated once and loaded whenever lavish_required=true.
Resolve plan, design, comparison, diagram, table-heavy report, roadmap, HTML artifact, and structured human decision into lavish_required=true.
The model cannot silently choose prose for a required artifact.
Add Lavish requirement to task envelopes
Carry artifact type, lavish_required, human_review_required, and acceptance key from intake through brief, spawn, task state, and completion.
Missing required fields fail before spawn.
Resolve current Lavish guidance before authoring
Execute lavish-axi --help, lavish-axi design, and every matching playbook before writing the first HTML revision.
Guidance receipt with CLI version and playbook IDs.
An artifact cannot claim the Lavish path if guidance was skipped.
Provide a responsive, offline-first HTML shell with print support, stable annotation targets, diagrams, tables, decisions, task export, and strong mobile behavior.
Pass light, dark, narrow, print, and no-network rendering checks.
Use the CLI against the canonical HTML path and record the session identity.
No artifact is presented as reviewable until Lavish confirms the session.
Register the existing fm-procevent-lavish adapter and bind feedback to the task and owning worker.
A restart after arm can still route captured feedback to the correct task.
Prevent teardown while a Lavish review remains open; route every feedback batch to the same worker unless recovery proves replacement is necessary.
Context is preserved across iterative design feedback.
Embed Approve, Revise, and Stop controls using Lavish structured input. An empty close is not approval.
Implementation begins only on an explicit approval bound to the current artifact hash.
Record artifact hash, Lavish version, playbooks, layout checks, feedback rounds, final decision, and decision actor.
Any byte change invalidates approval until re-reviewed.
Surface Lavish layout findings, let the human queue selected repairs, and require a newer clean render for resolution.
A prior check at one viewport cannot clear a failure at another viewport.
Cover missing CLI, unsupported version, open failure, feedback, Send & End, empty close, interrupted poll, restart recovery, stale artifact, and owner replacement.
Portable tests plus live opt-in test.
Every bypass attempt either blocks or is accurately labeled degraded.

epics.title: Python factory kernel and full routing
epics.goal: Keep the captain-facing driver fixed on Luna xhigh while Python makes routing inspectable, testable, and future-API ready.
tasks: Add firstmate_factory with modules for schemas, intake, routing, advisors, task graph, design gate, events, artifacts, setup, and API contracts.
Shell scripts become adapters; policy logic has one Python owner.
Specify task_type, complexity, risk, uncertainty, artifact, capabilities, delivery mode, authority, output contract, and provenance.
Unknown enums, missing mandatory fields, and conflicting provenance fail deterministically.
Record driver, route scout, design author, adversaries, implementers, PR reviewers, validators, and incident roles with exact harness/model/effort requirements.
The main driver profile is immutable: Pi + Luna + xhigh.
Implement the complete matrix in this design, with risk overlays and same-or-stronger fallback rules.
Golden fixtures cover every matrix cell and risk overlay.
Have Luna propose a structured request with evidence; validate and canonicalize it in Python before policy evaluation.
Raw prose never enters the deterministic rule evaluator.
Apply complexity floors, risk floors, capability eligibility, required gates, and exact role selection.
Same inputs and policy produce byte-stable decisions except IDs and timestamps.
Verify harness, model, effort, tool access, and authentication through current adapter discovery rather than name inference.
Unsupported profiles are removed only with concrete catalog evidence.
Integrate quota only inside the safe set
Reuse current quota evidence after class, risk, capability, effort, and review floors are fixed.
Quota can select among safe peers but cannot lower any floor.
Define a typed advisor contract that may return evidence, uncertainty, and raise recommendations but cannot directly select a lower route.
The final deterministic decision records whether advice was used or ignored.
Use historical structured outcomes for completion-horizon, failure-rate, and route-risk estimates without free-text ML.
Unavailable or sparse data becomes unknown, never a downgrade.
Provide a plugin point for calibrated structured prediction only after sufficient labeled outcomes; allow only raise-level or require-review suggestions.
No model output can lower risk, effort, capability, review, or authority.
For unresolved semantic or architectural ambiguity, spawn a read-only Claude Code/Fable scout with a strict JSON return schema and evidence references.
The scout does not edit, spawn children, or authorize work.
When Luna classification, Python evidence, or Claude scout conflict, choose the monotonic safer route or abstain for the captain.
No array order, cost, or model preference resolves a safety conflict.
Compile objective, role, exact profile, artifact contract, design hash, gates, acceptance, and return schema into the worker brief.
A worker can execute without reconstructing routing intent.
Require fm-spawn to receive and verify the exact route decision; refuse harness/model/effort mismatch before external launch.
Changing any selected axis after decision causes refusal.
Fix every Firstmate and secondmate driver to Luna xhigh
Ensure primary and persistent secondmate drivers launch as Pi/Luna xhigh; only their project workers vary by policy.
No routing policy can move the captain-facing driver to another model.
Compare current prose routing to candidate Python decisions, classify differences, and collect outcomes.
No live enforcement until unsafe downgrade count is zero and human review passes.

epics.title: Human-first design gate
epics.goal: Front-load human judgment into a reviewed design, then let the factory execute without repeatedly asking for design intent.
tasks: Require a design for cross-app changes, new services, data contracts, migrations, production/security work, novel architecture, C3/C4 complexity, or explicit captain request.
A worker cannot begin implementation while required design evidence is absent.
Define mandatory sections: goal, current evidence, desired behavior, boundaries, architecture, interfaces, state, failure modes, security, rollout, rollback, tests, and task graph.
Every required section has deterministic presence and evidence checks.
Use Fable high for standard architecture, Fable xhigh for hard/critical architecture, or Luna xhigh for bounded designs when Fable is unavailable and degraded independence is acceptable.
Profile choice and degradation are explicit in the design receipt.
Hash the exact HTML and supporting evidence before adversarial review.
Use Sol high to attack architecture, concurrency, state, security, authority, migration, rollback, performance, and cost.
Every P0/P1 names a concrete failure mechanism.
Use Luna xhigh to test file/module ownership, interfaces, sequencing, acceptance tests, operational clarity, and whether a coding agent can build without guessing.
Missing executable detail blocks implementation readiness.
Add a distinct-model gate for critical designs
Require at least one different model/context for R3/R4 or C4 designs; scope-only same-model review is insufficient unless the captain accepts degradation.
The receipt never overstates reviewer independence.
Implement finding ledger and closure authority
Track finding severity, mechanism, evidence, required change, disposition, and closer. Authors may fix but cannot clear P0/P1.
Serious findings require reviewer or captain closure.
Present design in Lavish for human decision
Show the resolved design, surviving findings, accepted risks, and exact execution scope with structured Approve, Revise, and Stop controls.
No implementation transition occurs on close, silence, or implied approval.
Bind human approval, design hash, review hashes, accepted risks, task-graph version, and authority scope.
Any material design edit invalidates approval.
Compile approved design into a task graph
Generate bounded tasks, dependencies, exact routes, acceptance checks, PR boundaries, and expected artifacts from the approved design.
Every task traces to an approved design section and acceptance criterion.
Classify deviations in architecture, scope, authority, security, migration, and acceptance; material drift returns to Lavish, bounded fixes remain autonomous.
The factory cannot silently implement a different design.
Cover stale design, missing adversary, same-model overclaim, author self-clear, silent close, accepted risk without captain, and drift after approval.
All unsafe paths block before implementation.

epics.title: Hands-off dark local software factory
epics.goal: Execute the approved task graph with sparse human interruption and strong evidence.
tasks: Model ready, running, waiting, blocked, review, fixing, PR-ready, landed, failed, and superseded states without replacing existing Firstmate authority.
State transitions are legal, idempotent, and recoverable.
Release tasks when dependencies and design gates are satisfied; serialize only semantic conflicts and shared mutable external state.
Same-file overlap alone does not block independent work.
Compile worker briefs from graph nodes
Include exact design references, route decision, constraints, acceptance tests, validation commands, and return record.
Workers never have to infer global plan intent.
Use existing Firstmate isolation and Herdr backends with route-bound harness/model/effort.
Every worker is isolated and matches its decision.
Translate existing status, backend state, no-mistakes state, and artifact events into typed factory events.
Chat prose is never the sole state authority.
Dark mode hides routine progress and surfaces only design decisions, credentials, destructive authority, failed validation, unrecoverable blockers, and final outcomes.
Hands-off execution produces no periodic no-change chatter.
Recover dead agents, retry transient tool failures, reconcile stale state, and preserve unlanded work within explicit attempt limits.
Repeated failure escalates with evidence instead of looping.
Implement task replanning within approved bounds
Allow Luna xhigh to split or reorder tasks when the design and acceptance remain unchanged; record the graph diff.
Material drift invokes E3.12 rather than self-authorizing.
Search trusted base-revision project skills/commands for pr-self-review and select the repository-owned contract.
Candidate branch cannot replace the gate that judges it.
Run PR self-review on final head
For Phynd Cloud, execute the exact committed pr-self-review procedure, including Keanu lenses, adversarial verification, fixes, and proof.
Any new commit makes the attestation stale.
Luna xhigh or Sol high by diff class
Use Luna xhigh for C1/C2 diffs; use Sol high plus an independent skeptic for C3/C4, security, migration, or production changes.
The implementer cannot be the only verifier of a serious finding.
Keep no-mistakes authoritative for its review/fix/test/document/push/PR/CI pipeline; use self-review as readiness, not a competing verdict.
No serial manual clean-verdict gate is added beside no-mistakes.
Bind task graph node, design hash, route, self-review, no-mistakes run, PR head, and CI state.
A PR cannot be reported ready against a different head.
Check implemented interfaces, files, behavior, tests, and accepted constraints against the approved design.
Stop at green PR-ready unless the project's explicit yolo posture authorizes merge; never broaden destructive or security authority.
No factory task infers merge authority.
Confirm landing, close obligations, retain artifacts/evidence, and use existing guarded teardown.
Use Lavish to show approved design, task graph, active workers, decisions, PRs, failures, and final outcomes without becoming authority.
The board can disappear without changing execution.
Execute a routine feature, hard migration, design revision, failed worker recovery, stale self-review, and multiple parallel tasks.
Only expected human decisions interrupt the run.

epics.title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
epics.goal: Turn fm-setup into the only command required to install, update, repair, and enter the Firstmate experience.
tasks: Default command means ensure tested toolchain, ensure repos/config, doctor, ensure Herdr/Firstmate, and attach. Define --no-launch, doctor, repair, update, and --json.
Rerunning the default command is safe and convergent.
Pin compatible versions, URLs, checksums, feature probes, and update policy for Python, Node, Git/GH, Herdr, Pi, Lavish, AXIs, no-mistakes, and treehouse.
Setup never blindly installs untested latest versions.
Replace the large setup shell with a two-stage bootstrap
Keep a tiny POSIX entry script that locates or bootstraps a managed Python runtime, then execs the Python setup application.
All stateful setup logic is testable Python.
Add setup lock and resumable journal
Prevent concurrent installers and record completed/started phases with immutable inputs.
Kill at any phase and rerun without corruption or duplicate work.
Support macOS arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64 with explicit unsupported-platform failure.
No command is selected by fuzzy OS guessing.
Install tools under ~/.local/share/phynd-firstmate with stable shims in ~/.local/bin and a managed shell-profile block.
No duplicate PATH lines and no mutation outside owned blocks.
Download and verify a tested standalone runtime or uv-managed Python when a compatible interpreter is absent.
A fresh supported machine can reach the Python setup phase without manual Python installation.
Download verified Node artifacts into the managed toolchain instead of requiring Homebrew or a preexisting npm.
Pi and AXIs can install on a machine with no prior Node.
Use verified managed binaries where supported or a platform package adapter with explicit elevation/device-flow handling.
Missing Git/GH no longer produces an instruction to install them manually.
Install the tested stable version; use herdr update --handoff or live handoff when a server is active; validate required workspace/agent APIs.
Running panes survive a compatible update; incompatible state fails with recovery instructions.
Install the tested Pi version with supply-chain-safe flags and verify model/thinking CLI support.
The driver can be launched with Luna and xhigh on every supported platform.
Install or update Lavish and AXIs
Install tested Lavish, gh-axi, chrome-devtools-axi, tasks-axi, and quota-axi; run idempotent hook/setup commands where supported.
Lavish CLI and the Firstmate Lavish adapter pass smoke checks; Pi does not depend on unsupported Lavish session hooks.
Install or update no-mistakes and treehouse
Use tested installers/versions and feature probes.
No project work starts if required features are absent.
Fast-forward a clean clone or install a new versioned code root and atomically switch the managed current link; never overwrite dirty/diverged work.
Clone/register if absent; guarded fetch/fast-forward only when safe; preserve local work and submodules.
A dirty or divergent clone is preserved and surfaced, not reset.
Run init/doctor idempotently for required projects and verify canonical lint/test commands.
Setup blocks launch only on actionable validation prerequisites.
Merge only Firstmate-owned keys for Pi, Herdr, dispatch, prompt, and presentation settings; back up before changing user files.
Repeated runs produce no diff and never clobber unrelated user settings.
Install driver prompt and role prompts
Materialize project-local Pi APPEND_SYSTEM and managed child role prompts with hashes and provenance.
The active driver prompt is guaranteed before launch.
Handle authentication as a resumable gate
Detect GH and model-provider auth; automatically start supported device/browser login and resume setup after confirmation.
The user is never told to research a separate install command; unavoidable identity interaction is explicit and resumable.
Start or attach to a dedicated phynd-firstmate session using the headless server path when needed.
Reruns do not create duplicate servers.
Find or create the Firstmate workspace
Match canonical code root and label; reuse a healthy workspace or create one and capture its root pane.
Reruns do not create duplicate workspaces.
Find, recover, or start the driver agent
Reuse a live firstmate agent; recover a dead one without discarding state; otherwise start Pi/Luna/xhigh with exact FM_HOME and managed PATH.
Exactly one live driver exists in the named session.
Focus the Firstmate workspace and exec herdr --session phynd-firstmate. When already inside Herdr, focus the target instead of nesting a client.
Successful setup ends with the user looking at the Firstmate window.
Add doctor, repair, and machine-readable output
Report owned paths, versions, feature probes, auth, prompt hash, session/workspace/agent state, and safe remediation.
Every failure names the exact phase and safe next action.

Cover clean machine, partial install, old/new versions, no network, bad checksum, concurrent setup, dirty repo, running Herdr, stale workspace, auth interruption, kill/restart, and shell-profile idempotency.
All supported failure points converge or fail without damage.
Opt-in tests on macOS arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64 using clean user homes and real Herdr/Pi/Lavish.
Each platform reaches an attached Firstmate pane from one command.
Retain prior tested toolchain/code root and allow atomic rollback when an update fails doctor or launch.
Rollback never rewrites project work or task state.

epics.title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
epics.goal: Keep milestone one local while making the Python core callable by other engineer-local agents later.
tasks: Keep intake, route, task graph, events, decisions, artifact feedback, and outcomes independent of terminal UI and file path details.
The same schemas can be used by CLI, Unix socket, or cloud API.
Expose a local Python CLI facade
Provide submit, status, events, answer, artifact-feedback, and cancel commands against the same factory core.
No CLI path bypasses policy or authority.
Support deterministic event consumption with after/cursor semantics.
Restarting a client cannot silently skip events.
Specify a local-only HTTP or JSON-RPC adapter, per-user token, peer identity, rate limit, and audit records.
No external network listener is enabled in milestone one.
Map external requests to a paired human
Require every local-agent request to resolve an engineer/captain authority and decision channel.
No agent-to-factory call creates anonymous authority.
Map artifact feedback into the Lavish contract
Represent queued feedback and decisions in the same schema the local API will later expose.
Remote/local clients cannot forge approval without the paired human identity.
Separate per-engineer local factory, remote worker execution, multi-tenant control plane, secrets, tenancy, audit, and policy distribution.
Milestone one does not acquire distributed-system scope.
Run the same conformance suite against in-process core and CLI; reserve adapter tests for the later implementation.

epics.title: Evaluation, rollout, and trust promotion
epics.goal: Promote from reviewed design to trusted factory based on evidence, not confidence theater.
tasks: Build the complete routing fixture matrix
Cover every task type × complexity cell, risk overlay, capability, profile availability, quota state, and advisor conflict.
Run the E0 corpus on each prompt, communication-skill, or driver-model change.
Chat brevity and artifact completeness remain within approved bounds.
Check required sections, annotation targets, layout, mobile, print, decision controls, source evidence, and task export.
No required artifact is accepted as a static unreviewed page.
Use known flawed designs to test serious-finding recall, false-positive rejection, and author self-clear prevention.
All curated critical defects are found or the route abstains.
Track human interruptions, unnecessary asks, worker retries, design drift, PR rework, first-pass validation, and time to PR-ready.
Routine approved plans run without human interruption except defined authority gates.
Track install/update/repair success, launch latency, duplicate prevention, and rollback on the platform matrix.
One command reaches a healthy attached driver on every supported clean image.
Use the new prompt, artifact contract, and router in observation mode while current routing remains live.
No unexplained lower route or skipped Lavish requirement.
Present shadow outcomes, failures, degraded paths, and exact policy diffs in Lavish.
Live routing/gates are not enabled without explicit approval.
Enable prompt and Lavish gates first
Promote the revised driver prompt and artifact requirements before enabling factory routing.
Subsequent implementation benefits from the corrected quality contract.
Enable deterministic routing and design gate
Bind route decisions and approved designs to new tasks.
No new required-design task reaches implementation without approval.
Allow approved task graphs to execute autonomously under existing authority and quality gates.
Only defined human decisions interrupt execution.
Disable each enforcement layer independently and prove current Firstmate behavior and unlanded work remain intact.
Rollback never discards work or weakens authority silently.
Document one-command startup, prompt modes, Lavish loop, routing, design approval, factory behavior, failures, recovery, and future API seam.
A new engineer can launch and understand the factory without oral history.
Human reviews final evidence and chooses Accept, Extend, or Roll Back.
The milestone closes only on an explicit decision.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Implement Python statistics baseline
tasks.detail: Use historical structured outcomes for completion-horizon, failure-rate, and route-risk estimates without free-text ML.
tasks.acceptance: Unavailable or sparse data becomes unknown, never a downgrade.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Add optional ML shadow advisor
tasks.detail: Provide a plugin point for calibrated structured prediction only after sufficient labeled outcomes; allow only raise-level or require-review suggestions.
tasks.acceptance: No model output can lower risk, effort, capability, review, or authority.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Add Claude semantic route scout
tasks.detail: For unresolved semantic or architectural ambiguity, spawn a read-only Claude Code/Fable scout with a strict JSON return schema and evidence references.
tasks.acceptance: The scout does not edit, spawn children, or authorize work.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Adjudicate conflicting route advice
tasks.detail: When Luna classification, Python evidence, or Claude scout conflict, choose the monotonic safer route or abstain for the captain.
tasks.acceptance: No array order, cost, or model preference resolves a safety conflict.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Bind route decision to briefs
tasks.detail: Compile objective, role, exact profile, artifact contract, design hash, gates, acceptance, and return schema into the worker brief.
tasks.acceptance: A worker can execute without reconstructing routing intent.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Bind route decision to spawn
tasks.detail: Require fm-spawn to receive and verify the exact route decision; refuse harness/model/effort mismatch before external launch.
tasks.acceptance: Changing any selected axis after decision causes refusal.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Fix every Firstmate and secondmate driver to Luna xhigh
tasks.detail: Ensure primary and persistent secondmate drivers launch as Pi/Luna xhigh; only their project workers vary by policy.
tasks.acceptance: No routing policy can move the captain-facing driver to another model.

tasks.epic_title: Python factory kernel and full routing
tasks.title: Build routing shadow and evaluation
tasks.detail: Compare current prose routing to candidate Python decisions, classify differences, and collect outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: No live enforcement until unsafe downgrade count is zero and human review passes.

tasks.title: Classify when design is required
tasks.detail: Require a design for cross-app changes, new services, data contracts, migrations, production/security work, novel architecture, C3/C4 complexity, or explicit captain request.
tasks.acceptance: A worker cannot begin implementation while required design evidence is absent.

tasks.title: Create design artifact contracts
tasks.detail: Define mandatory sections: goal, current evidence, desired behavior, boundaries, architecture, interfaces, state, failure modes, security, rollout, rollback, tests, and task graph.
tasks.acceptance: Every required section has deterministic presence and evidence checks.

tasks.title: Select the design author
tasks.detail: Use Fable high for standard architecture, Fable xhigh for hard/critical architecture, or Luna xhigh for bounded designs when Fable is unavailable and degraded independence is acceptable.
tasks.acceptance: Profile choice and degradation are explicit in the design receipt.

tasks.title: Freeze the candidate design
tasks.detail: Hash the exact HTML and supporting evidence before adversarial review.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewers evaluate the same bytes.

tasks.title: Run technical/failure adversary
tasks.detail: Use Sol high to attack architecture, concurrency, state, security, authority, migration, rollback, performance, and cost.
tasks.acceptance: Every P0/P1 names a concrete failure mechanism.

tasks.title: Run implementation-completeness adversary
tasks.detail: Use Luna xhigh to test file/module ownership, interfaces, sequencing, acceptance tests, operational clarity, and whether a coding agent can build without guessing.
tasks.acceptance: Missing executable detail blocks implementation readiness.

tasks.title: Add a distinct-model gate for critical designs
tasks.detail: Require at least one different model/context for R3/R4 or C4 designs; scope-only same-model review is insufficient unless the captain accepts degradation.
tasks.acceptance: The receipt never overstates reviewer independence.

tasks.title: Implement finding ledger and closure authority
tasks.detail: Track finding severity, mechanism, evidence, required change, disposition, and closer. Authors may fix but cannot clear P0/P1.
tasks.acceptance: Serious findings require reviewer or captain closure.

tasks.title: Present design in Lavish for human decision
tasks.detail: Show the resolved design, surviving findings, accepted risks, and exact execution scope with structured Approve, Revise, and Stop controls.
tasks.acceptance: No implementation transition occurs on close, silence, or implied approval.

tasks.title: Write the design approval receipt
tasks.detail: Bind human approval, design hash, review hashes, accepted risks, task-graph version, and authority scope.
tasks.acceptance: Any material design edit invalidates approval.

tasks.title: Compile approved design into a task graph
tasks.detail: Generate bounded tasks, dependencies, exact routes, acceptance checks, PR boundaries, and expected artifacts from the approved design.
tasks.acceptance: Every task traces to an approved design section and acceptance criterion.

tasks.title: Detect implementation drift
tasks.detail: Classify deviations in architecture, scope, authority, security, migration, and acceptance; material drift returns to Lavish, bounded fixes remain autonomous.
tasks.acceptance: The factory cannot silently implement a different design.

tasks.title: Test design-gate bypasses
tasks.detail: Cover stale design, missing adversary, same-model overclaim, author self-clear, silent close, accepted risk without captain, and drift after approval.
tasks.acceptance: All unsafe paths block before implementation.

tasks.title: Define task-graph runtime states
tasks.detail: Model ready, running, waiting, blocked, review, fixing, PR-ready, landed, failed, and superseded states without replacing existing Firstmate authority.
tasks.acceptance: State transitions are legal, idempotent, and recoverable.

tasks.title: Implement dependency scheduler
tasks.detail: Release tasks when dependencies and design gates are satisfied; serialize only semantic conflicts and shared mutable external state.
tasks.acceptance: Same-file overlap alone does not block independent work.

tasks.title: Compile worker briefs from graph nodes
tasks.detail: Include exact design references, route decision, constraints, acceptance tests, validation commands, and return record.
tasks.acceptance: Workers never have to infer global plan intent.

tasks.title: Spawn exact worker profiles
tasks.detail: Use existing Firstmate isolation and Herdr backends with route-bound harness/model/effort.
tasks.acceptance: Every worker is isolated and matches its decision.

tasks.title: Normalize worker milestones
tasks.detail: Translate existing status, backend state, no-mistakes state, and artifact events into typed factory events.
tasks.acceptance: Chat prose is never the sole state authority.

tasks.title: Implement sparse captain communication
tasks.detail: Dark mode hides routine progress and surfaces only design decisions, credentials, destructive authority, failed validation, unrecoverable blockers, and final outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Hands-off execution produces no periodic no-change chatter.

tasks.title: Add bounded automatic recovery
tasks.detail: Recover dead agents, retry transient tool failures, reconcile stale state, and preserve unlanded work within explicit attempt limits.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated failure escalates with evidence instead of looping.

tasks.title: Implement task replanning within approved bounds
tasks.detail: Allow Luna xhigh to split or reorder tasks when the design and acceptance remain unchanged; record the graph diff.
tasks.acceptance: Material drift invokes E3.12 rather than self-authorizing.

tasks.title: Resolve repository PR self-review capability
tasks.detail: Search trusted base-revision project skills/commands for pr-self-review and select the repository-owned contract.
tasks.acceptance: Candidate branch cannot replace the gate that judges it.

tasks.title: Run PR self-review on final head
tasks.detail: For Phynd Cloud, execute the exact committed pr-self-review procedure, including Keanu lenses, adversarial verification, fixes, and proof.
tasks.acceptance: Any new commit makes the attestation stale.
tasks.owner: Luna xhigh or Sol high by diff class

tasks.title: Route self-review by diff complexity
tasks.detail: Use Luna xhigh for C1/C2 diffs; use Sol high plus an independent skeptic for C3/C4, security, migration, or production changes.
tasks.acceptance: The implementer cannot be the only verifier of a serious finding.

tasks.title: Integrate no-mistakes without duplicating it
tasks.detail: Keep no-mistakes authoritative for its review/fix/test/document/push/PR/CI pipeline; use self-review as readiness, not a competing verdict.
tasks.acceptance: No serial manual clean-verdict gate is added beside no-mistakes.

tasks.title: Track PR and CI outcomes
tasks.detail: Bind task graph node, design hash, route, self-review, no-mistakes run, PR head, and CI state.
tasks.acceptance: A PR cannot be reported ready against a different head.

tasks.title: Verify design compliance before PR-ready
tasks.detail: Check implemented interfaces, files, behavior, tests, and accepted constraints against the approved design.
tasks.acceptance: Unapproved drift blocks PR-ready.

tasks.title: Preserve captain merge authority
tasks.detail: Stop at green PR-ready unless the project's explicit yolo posture authorizes merge; never broaden destructive or security authority.
tasks.acceptance: No factory task infers merge authority.

tasks.title: Complete and clean tasks safely
tasks.detail: Confirm landing, close obligations, retain artifacts/evidence, and use existing guarded teardown.
tasks.acceptance: No unlanded work is discarded.

tasks.title: Build the factory control-room artifact
tasks.detail: Use Lavish to show approved design, task graph, active workers, decisions, PRs, failures, and final outcomes without becoming authority.
tasks.acceptance: The board can disappear without changing execution.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end dark-factory scenarios
tasks.detail: Execute a routine feature, hard migration, design revision, failed worker recovery, stale self-review, and multiple parallel tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Only expected human decisions interrupt the run.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Define the setup product contract
tasks.detail: Default command means ensure tested toolchain, ensure repos/config, doctor, ensure Herdr/Firstmate, and attach. Define --no-launch, doctor, repair, update, and --json.
tasks.acceptance: Rerunning the default command is safe and convergent.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Create a tested toolchain lock
tasks.detail: Pin compatible versions, URLs, checksums, feature probes, and update policy for Python, Node, Git/GH, Herdr, Pi, Lavish, AXIs, no-mistakes, and treehouse.
tasks.acceptance: Setup never blindly installs untested latest versions.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Replace the large setup shell with a two-stage bootstrap
tasks.detail: Keep a tiny POSIX entry script that locates or bootstraps a managed Python runtime, then execs the Python setup application.
tasks.acceptance: All stateful setup logic is testable Python.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Add setup lock and resumable journal
tasks.detail: Prevent concurrent installers and record completed/started phases with immutable inputs.
tasks.acceptance: Kill at any phase and rerun without corruption or duplicate work.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Implement platform and architecture adapters
tasks.detail: Support macOS arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64 with explicit unsupported-platform failure.
tasks.acceptance: No command is selected by fuzzy OS guessing.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Create a managed install root
tasks.detail: Install tools under ~/.local/share/phynd-firstmate with stable shims in ~/.local/bin and a managed shell-profile block.
tasks.acceptance: No duplicate PATH lines and no mutation outside owned blocks.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Bootstrap Python without prior Python
tasks.detail: Download and verify a tested standalone runtime or uv-managed Python when a compatible interpreter is absent.
tasks.acceptance: A fresh supported machine can reach the Python setup phase without manual Python installation.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install and update managed Node/npm
tasks.detail: Download verified Node artifacts into the managed toolchain instead of requiring Homebrew or a preexisting npm.
tasks.acceptance: Pi and AXIs can install on a machine with no prior Node.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Ensure Git and GitHub CLI
tasks.detail: Use verified managed binaries where supported or a platform package adapter with explicit elevation/device-flow handling.
tasks.acceptance: Missing Git/GH no longer produces an instruction to install them manually.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install or update Herdr safely
tasks.detail: Install the tested stable version; use herdr update --handoff or live handoff when a server is active; validate required workspace/agent APIs.
tasks.acceptance: Running panes survive a compatible update; incompatible state fails with recovery instructions.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install or update Pi
tasks.detail: Install the tested Pi version with supply-chain-safe flags and verify model/thinking CLI support.
tasks.acceptance: The driver can be launched with Luna and xhigh on every supported platform.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install or update Lavish and AXIs
tasks.detail: Install tested Lavish, gh-axi, chrome-devtools-axi, tasks-axi, and quota-axi; run idempotent hook/setup commands where supported.
tasks.acceptance: Lavish CLI and the Firstmate Lavish adapter pass smoke checks; Pi does not depend on unsupported Lavish session hooks.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install or update no-mistakes and treehouse
tasks.detail: Use tested installers/versions and feature probes.
tasks.acceptance: No project work starts if required features are absent.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Ensure the Firstmate fork safely
tasks.detail: Fast-forward a clean clone or install a new versioned code root and atomically switch the managed current link; never overwrite dirty/diverged work.
tasks.acceptance: Updates cannot destroy local changes.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Ensure Phynd Cloud safely
tasks.detail: Clone/register if absent; guarded fetch/fast-forward only when safe; preserve local work and submodules.
tasks.acceptance: A dirty or divergent clone is preserved and surfaced, not reset.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Initialize and verify no-mistakes
tasks.detail: Run init/doctor idempotently for required projects and verify canonical lint/test commands.
tasks.acceptance: Setup blocks launch only on actionable validation prerequisites.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Reconcile configuration by ownership
tasks.detail: Merge only Firstmate-owned keys for Pi, Herdr, dispatch, prompt, and presentation settings; back up before changing user files.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated runs produce no diff and never clobber unrelated user settings.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Install driver prompt and role prompts
tasks.detail: Materialize project-local Pi APPEND_SYSTEM and managed child role prompts with hashes and provenance.
tasks.acceptance: The active driver prompt is guaranteed before launch.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Handle authentication as a resumable gate
tasks.detail: Detect GH and model-provider auth; automatically start supported device/browser login and resume setup after confirmation.
tasks.acceptance: The user is never told to research a separate install command; unavoidable identity interaction is explicit and resumable.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Ensure a named Herdr session
tasks.detail: Start or attach to a dedicated phynd-firstmate session using the headless server path when needed.
tasks.acceptance: Reruns do not create duplicate servers.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Find or create the Firstmate workspace
tasks.detail: Match canonical code root and label; reuse a healthy workspace or create one and capture its root pane.
tasks.acceptance: Reruns do not create duplicate workspaces.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Find, recover, or start the driver agent
tasks.detail: Reuse a live firstmate agent; recover a dead one without discarding state; otherwise start Pi/Luna/xhigh with exact FM_HOME and managed PATH.
tasks.acceptance: Exactly one live driver exists in the named session.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Focus and attach automatically
tasks.detail: Focus the Firstmate workspace and exec herdr --session phynd-firstmate. When already inside Herdr, focus the target instead of nesting a client.
tasks.acceptance: Successful setup ends with the user looking at the Firstmate window.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Add doctor, repair, and machine-readable output
tasks.detail: Report owned paths, versions, feature probes, auth, prompt hash, session/workspace/agent state, and safe remediation.
tasks.acceptance: Every failure names the exact phase and safe next action.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Build setup fault-injection tests
tasks.detail: Cover clean machine, partial install, old/new versions, no network, bad checksum, concurrent setup, dirty repo, running Herdr, stale workspace, auth interruption, kill/restart, and shell-profile idempotency.
tasks.acceptance: All supported failure points converge or fail without damage.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Run real platform smoke matrix
tasks.detail: Opt-in tests on macOS arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64 using clean user homes and real Herdr/Pi/Lavish.
tasks.acceptance: Each platform reaches an attached Firstmate pane from one command.

tasks.epic_title: Idempotent zero-touch setup and Herdr launch
tasks.title: Add guarded rollback
tasks.detail: Retain prior tested toolchain/code root and allow atomic rollback when an update fails doctor or launch.
tasks.acceptance: Rollback never rewrites project work or task state.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Stabilize service-neutral schemas
tasks.detail: Keep intake, route, task graph, events, decisions, artifact feedback, and outcomes independent of terminal UI and file path details.
tasks.acceptance: The same schemas can be used by CLI, Unix socket, or cloud API.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Expose a local Python CLI facade
tasks.detail: Provide submit, status, events, answer, artifact-feedback, and cancel commands against the same factory core.
tasks.acceptance: No CLI path bypasses policy or authority.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Add cursor-based local event reads
tasks.detail: Support deterministic event consumption with after/cursor semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Restarting a client cannot silently skip events.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Design the loopback/Unix-socket adapter
tasks.detail: Specify a local-only HTTP or JSON-RPC adapter, per-user token, peer identity, rate limit, and audit records.
tasks.acceptance: No external network listener is enabled in milestone one.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Map external requests to a paired human
tasks.detail: Require every local-agent request to resolve an engineer/captain authority and decision channel.
tasks.acceptance: No agent-to-factory call creates anonymous authority.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Map artifact feedback into the Lavish contract
tasks.detail: Represent queued feedback and decisions in the same schema the local API will later expose.
tasks.acceptance: Remote/local clients cannot forge approval without the paired human identity.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Document cloud evolution boundaries
tasks.detail: Separate per-engineer local factory, remote worker execution, multi-tenant control plane, secrets, tenancy, audit, and policy distribution.
tasks.acceptance: Milestone one does not acquire distributed-system scope.

tasks.epic_title: Local-agent interface seam for the future cloud
tasks.title: Contract-test CLI and future adapter
tasks.detail: Run the same conformance suite against in-process core and CLI; reserve adapter tests for the later implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Behavior is transport-independent.

tasks.title: Build the complete routing fixture matrix
tasks.detail: Cover every task type × complexity cell, risk overlay, capability, profile availability, quota state, and advisor conflict.
tasks.acceptance: Unsafe downgrade count is zero.

tasks.title: Measure prompt policy continuously
tasks.detail: Run the E0 corpus on each prompt, communication-skill, or driver-model change.
tasks.acceptance: Chat brevity and artifact completeness remain within approved bounds.

tasks.title: Measure Lavish artifact quality
tasks.detail: Check required sections, annotation targets, layout, mobile, print, decision controls, source evidence, and task export.
tasks.acceptance: No required artifact is accepted as a static unreviewed page.

tasks.title: Measure design-adversary effectiveness
tasks.detail: Use known flawed designs to test serious-finding recall, false-positive rejection, and author self-clear prevention.
tasks.acceptance: All curated critical defects are found or the route abstains.

tasks.title: Measure factory autonomy
tasks.detail: Track human interruptions, unnecessary asks, worker retries, design drift, PR rework, first-pass validation, and time to PR-ready.
tasks.acceptance: Routine approved plans run without human interruption except defined authority gates.

tasks.title: Measure setup convergence
tasks.detail: Track install/update/repair success, launch latency, duplicate prevention, and rollback on the platform matrix.
tasks.acceptance: One command reaches a healthy attached driver on every supported clean image.

tasks.title: Run shadow mode
tasks.detail: Use the new prompt, artifact contract, and router in observation mode while current routing remains live.
tasks.acceptance: No unexplained lower route or skipped Lavish requirement.

tasks.title: Human-review enforcement change
tasks.detail: Present shadow outcomes, failures, degraded paths, and exact policy diffs in Lavish.
tasks.acceptance: Live routing/gates are not enabled without explicit approval.

tasks.title: Enable prompt and Lavish gates first
tasks.detail: Promote the revised driver prompt and artifact requirements before enabling factory routing.
tasks.acceptance: Subsequent implementation benefits from the corrected quality contract.

tasks.title: Enable deterministic routing and design gate
tasks.detail: Bind route decisions and approved designs to new tasks.
tasks.acceptance: No new required-design task reaches implementation without approval.

tasks.title: Enable dark factory execution
tasks.detail: Allow approved task graphs to execute autonomously under existing authority and quality gates.
tasks.acceptance: Only defined human decisions interrupt execution.

tasks.title: Run rollback drills
tasks.detail: Disable each enforcement layer independently and prove current Firstmate behavior and unlanded work remain intact.
tasks.acceptance: Rollback never discards work or weakens authority silently.

tasks.title: Publish operator and maintainer documentation
tasks.detail: Document one-command startup, prompt modes, Lavish loop, routing, design approval, factory behavior, failures, recovery, and future API seam.
tasks.acceptance: A new engineer can launch and understand the factory without oral history.

tasks.title: Record milestone-one acceptance
tasks.detail: Human reviews final evidence and chooses Accept, Extend, or Roll Back.
tasks.acceptance: The milestone closes only on an explicit decision.
